categories.main_business_segments: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. operates three primary business segments: Life Science, Medical Office, and Continuing Care Retirement Community (CCRC). The Life Science segment includes laboratory and office space leased to biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies. The Medical Office segment consists of medical office buildings (MOBs) and hospitals, while the CCRC segment comprises retirement communities offering a continuum of care. There are also non-reportable segments, primarily consisting of loans receivable, marketable debt securities, and joint venture interests in senior housing assets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Healthpeak's core business is the acquisition, development, ownership, leasing, and management of healthcare real estate. The company focuses on high-quality, purpose-built facilities with advanced infrastructure for life science tenants (e.g., specialized HVAC, lab equipment), and medical office buildings designed for healthcare delivery. Property management, redevelopment, and tenant improvement activities are central to maintaining and enhancing asset value.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies (life science segment), healthcare providers and hospital systems (medical office segment), and seniors seeking independent and assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing (CCRC segment). Major tenants include Amgen, Inc. and HCA Healthcare, Inc., with a focus on private pay markets and leading healthcare operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: Healthpeak operates exclusively in the United States, with a portfolio concentrated in key markets such as California (notably San Francisco and San Diego), Massachusetts (Boston/Cambridge), Texas, and Florida. The company’s life science assets are heavily concentrated in San Francisco (49%), San Diego (24%), and Boston (24%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Healthpeak operates as a downstream participant in the healthcare real estate supply chain, acting as a landlord, property developer, and asset manager. The company provides critical infrastructure and facilities to healthcare and life science tenants, rather than engaging in direct healthcare delivery or upstream supply activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on long-term value creation through investment in high-quality, private-pay healthcare real estate in stable, demographically attractive markets. Healthpeak emphasizes portfolio diversification across life science, medical office, and CCRC assets, disciplined capital allocation, sustainability (ESG), and maintaining strong tenant/operator relationships. R&D is reflected in property development, redevelopment, and the adoption of sustainable building practices, including LEED and ENERGY STAR certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Healthpeak generates revenue primarily through rental income from triple-net and gross leases, resident fees and services at CCRCs, and management fees from RIDEA structures. Additional income streams include tenant recoveries, government grants (e.g., CARES Act), and interest from loans receivable. The company also realizes gains from property sales and joint venture transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Healthpeak faces competition from other healthcare REITs, institutional investors, private equity, pension funds, and healthcare operators. Key competitors include Welltower, Ventas, and other large healthcare-focused REITs. Healthpeak positions itself as a leading S&P 500 healthcare REIT with a reputation for high-quality assets, strong tenant relationships, and a focus on private-pay, demographically driven markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Healthpeak had total assets of $15.8 billion, equity of $7.2 billion, and annual revenues of $2.06 billion. The company reported net income applicable to common shares of $498 million and Adjusted NOI of $1.1 billion. Healthpeak has demonstrated growth through acquisitions, development, and strategic portfolio repositioning, with a focus on maintaining an investment-grade balance sheet and ample liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Healthpeak’s value proposition centers on providing high-quality, specialized healthcare real estate in premier markets, offering stability and growth potential through demographic trends and private-pay models. The company differentiates itself through its focus on life science and medical office assets in top-tier research and healthcare hubs, strong tenant/operator partnerships, and a commitment to ESG leadership and operational excellence.
